description: This Java class defines a data structure named TransactionChangeData used in the Fineract loan portfolio module to represent a change in a loan transaction, including references to the old and new loan transactions.

classes.name: TransactionChangeData
classes.description: A data container class that holds the old transaction (if any) and the new transaction for a loan account change.

methods.name: TransactionChangeData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the old and new LoanTransaction objects.
